# DSH Background — Custom Background Images & Glassmorphism
**DSH Background** lets you upload your own photos or animated GIFs as the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI
background, then tune glassmorphism, opacity, typography, colors, and motion. Version 2 is adapted t
o the DSH `0.2.2-rc.1` settings and theme APIs and ships prebuilt in `lib/`; installing the plugin d
oes not require a build step.
## Install
Requires DeepSeek Harness `0.2.2-rc.1` or later in the `0.2.x` series.

## What’s new in v2
- **Six visual presets:** Night, Aurora, Crystal, Dune, Rose, and Forest apply a complete, coordinat

ed appearance recipe.
- **Portable custom themes:** save up to 24 named looks, apply or delete them,
and exchange versioned JSON theme files. Import validates every value before applying it; duplicate

names receive numeric suffixes instead of overwriting an existing look.
- **Task-oriented studio:**
Themes, Glass, Backdrop, and Type tabs replace the old accordion and the retired `settings.plugin.i

tem` master card.
- **Clearer controls:** accessible switches and buttons, selected/focus/disabled s

tates, keyboard-operated sliders, double-click slider reset, and section-level zone reset.
- **Live
miniature preview:** inspect the active palette and material before changing the main interface.
## Theme features
- Clear, frosted, and velvet materials; blur and global frost; six independent zone opacities for th

e base, sidebar, cards, inputs, overlays, and bubbles.
- Hex and color-picker controls for the accen

t, backdrop, and light/dark text colors.
- **Custom background images:** upload your own photos or a

nimated GIFs into separate light/dark playlists, with fixed/loop playback and manage mode.
- Spring-

damped adjustments, font scale and family, and animated aurora.
- A master switch that restores the
stock interface, persistent `localStorage` settings, cross-tab synchronization, and reduced-motion s

upport.
- Theme exports contain appearance settings only. Wallpaper images, wallpaper playlists, and
the master-switch state are never included.

## Development
Requires Node.js 22+ and pnpm 11.
[代码示例省略，未执行]
`pnpm bundle` builds the host modules, browser bundle, CSS modules, and declarations into `lib/`. Th
e DSH client packages and React remain external and are supplied by the host Web GUI. Prebuilt relea
se files are committed so source installs work without developer tooling.
